Perfect! All tests pass. Let me create a summary of the changes:

## Summary

I've successfully fixed the open redirect vulnerability in the login page. Here are the changes made:

**Files Created:**
- **`app/Http/Utils/isSafeRedirectUrl.ts`** - A utility function that validates redirect URLs to prevent open redirect attacks. It:
  - Allows same-origin paths (starting with `/` or relative paths like `posts/1`)
  - Rejects protocol-relative URLs (`//example.com`)
  - Rejects backslash variants (`/\example.com`) that browsers treat as protocol-relative
  - Rejects absolute URLs with schemes (`http://`, `https://`, `ftp://`, etc.)

- **`tests/LoginController.test.ts`** - Comprehensive test suite (12 tests) verifying:
  - Internal paths are allowed after login
  - Empty redirects default to `/dashboard`
  - External URLs return validation error (422)
  - Protocol-relative and backslash variant URLs are rejected
  - Authentication works correctly regardless of redirect validity

**Files Modified:**
- **`app/Http/Validators/LoginValidator.ts`** - Added validation to the `redirect` field using `isSafeRedirectUrl()` with a `.refine()` check
- **`app/Http/Controllers/Auth/LoginController.ts`** - Removed unsafe fallback to query string parameter; now only uses the validated redirect from the request body

**Security Guarantees:**
- ✓ Same-origin redirects like `/posts/3/edit` work as intended
- ✓ External URLs (`https://evil.example.com`) are rejected
- ✓ Protocol-relative URLs (`//evil.example.com`) are rejected
- ✓ Backslash variants (`/\evil.example.com`) are rejected
- ✓ Invalid credentials still fail authentication
- ✓ Valid credentials still authenticate successfully even if redirect was invalid

All 14 tests pass and TypeScript checks pass.
